about: Where the feedback pane (assets/feedback.js) sends what you submit: dev@web-summit.dinis's vault, over its append lane. Public on purpose: the append token can write to the lane and nothing else (it cannot list, read or delete; sgit.ai/api/append-lanes), and the key is the agent's PUBLIC encryption key, which the page seals each submission to. The vault key, the write key and the enum key are never here. A session key: when this agent's session ends, a new key and lane replace these (3 November 2026, temporary until the team's vault).
